# Icon compact with text

Figma: standalone symbol `Icon/Compact with text`, node `289:4481` (page Components,
`1:28`). Not a variant set. Measured as an instance inside [Tasks](Tasks.md)
(`2127:54656`).

A glyph and a short bold label - a due date, a count, a status line.

## Markup

```html
<span class="v27-icon-text">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><!-- glyph --></svg>
  Monday
</span>
```

The glyph is decorative when the label already says what it means. If it does not, give the
element an accessible name.

## Classes

| Class | What it is |
|---|---|
| `.v27-icon-text` | the row |

The glyph is styled by descendant selector rather than its own class, because Figma treats
it as a slot with no properties of its own.

## Values

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| gap | `--v27-spacing-s` (8px) |
| glyph | `--v27-size-m` (24px) |
| label | Sm bold - Outfit 14 / 600 / auto |
| colour | `Foreground/Primary` for both |

Note the label is **Sm bold**, not Sm - this is a compact emphasis element, not a caption.
